composition_note: Preserve RFC rule order, cardinalities, fixed positions and extension points; insert charging-only members before the wildcard. RFC 8506 §3.2 permits repeated Failed-AVP, unlike TS 32.299 §6.4.3. The union retains the RFC bound. Redirect-Host-Cache-Time in §6.4.5 denotes RFC 6733 §6.14 Redirect-Max-Cache-Time; no new AVP code is assigned.
